name: Hand Finger Count Analysis
description: Counts fingers and validates hand anatomy — AI frequently generates incorrect finger counts (Nightingale & Farid, 2022).
algorithm: Hand Finger Count Analysis 분석 알고리즘
mechanism:
이 방법은 verifies hand and finger count accuracy for AI generation detection:

1. **Hand감지&Segmentation**: Hands are detected in each frame using object detection and precisely segmented. The hand mask isolates the palm and each finger for independent analysis.

2. **FingerCounting**: Each detected hand is analyzed for the number of distinct fingers. Using skeleton estimation and topology analysis, 본 방법은 counts finger-like protrusions from the palm. Correct count is 5 (4 fingers + 1 thumb) per hand. AI 생성기 (especially diffusion models) frequently produce 4, 6, or 7 fingers, making this one of the most reliable AI detection signals.

3. **FingerAnatomy검증**: Beyond counting, each finger's anatomy is checked: correct number of joints (3 for fingers, 2 for thumb), plausible length ratios (ring ≈ index > middle > pinky > thumb), and proper attachment to the palm. AI 생성기 may produce extra joints, impossible length ratios, or fingers merging/splitting.

4. **BilateralHand일관성**: When both hands are visible, they should be mirror-일관된 with the same finger count and proportions. 본 방법은 checks bilateral hand agreement — AI 생성기 may produce different finger counts on left and right hands.

5. **시간적Finger추적**: Finger count and geometry should remain 일관된 프레임 전반에 걸쳐. 본 방법은 tracks finger topology 시간에 따라 — AI 생성기 may produce different finger counts in different frames for the same hand, or show fingers appearing/disappearing during motion.
parameters: 분석 유형: 자동 통계\n점수 범위: 0(실제)~100(AI 생성)
source: 디지털 포렌식 및 AI 콘텐츠 탐지 관련 동료 검토 연구 기반.
useCase: AI 생성 콘텐츠를 탐지하기 위한 다중 신호 분석 파이프라인의 일부로 사용.
strengths: • 연구 기반 방법론\n• 빠른 계산 속도\n• 다른 탐지 방법과 보완적
limitations: • 정확도는 입력 품질에 따라 변동\n• 다른 방법과 함께 사용하는 것이 최적
